commit.message:
Add initial version of config-specific C header generator

Designed to replace the handwritten [`rvtest_config.h`](https://github.com/riscv/riscv-arch-test/blob/b27b0cd9e00a35b267cebd9a0ce2a6445bc47d64/config/sail/sail-RVA23S64/rvtest_config.h) files used in ACT4.

Creates a header from a UDB config that contains all of the supported extensions (`#define EXTENSION_SUPPORTED`) and all of the param values.

commit.message:
Address review feedback: dedup arrays and extract shared header base

- Extract shared logic into CfgHeaderBase module to reduce duplication
  between C and SystemVerilog header generators
- Deduplicate and sort integer array values before emitting defines
  to prevent duplicate macro definitions
- Deduplicate string array values after sanitization to prevent
  duplicate macro definitions from different strings that sanitize
  to the same identifier
- Update convention comments to reflect deduplication behavior

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

  (NAMEverPver_SUPPORTED) defines, e.g. S_SUPPORTED and S1P13_SUPPORTED

commit.message:
feat: add cfg-headers target to bin/chore gen for autofix

Add do_gen_cfg_header_golden to bin/chore so golden cfg header files
are automatically regenerated via 'chore gen cfg-headers' and as part
of 'chore gen all' (used by the autofix CI workflow).

Remove the Rake-based chore:update_golden_cfg_headers task from the
udb-gen Rakefile since bin/chore now handles this.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

fix: resolve Sorbet type errors in cfg_header_base module

- Change cfg_header_base.rb to typed: false since this mixin module
  depends on methods from its including class (SubcommandWithCommonOptions
  and TTY::Exit). Runtime type enforcement via sorbet-runtime still works.
- Add --ignore test to udb-gen sorbet/config to match udb gem convention.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

refactor: remove unused require in cfg_header_base

Remove unnecessary `require "udb/obj/extension"` - extension version
objects are provided at runtime by cfg_arch, not directly constructed.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
fix: address latest cfg header review feedback

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Move cfg header golden files to tests/data/golden, use chore gen in CI

- Move mc100-32-full-example golden .h/.svh files from
  tools/ruby-gems/udb-gen/test/data/golden/ to tests/data/golden/,
  matching the pattern used by other golden files (e.g., Xqci)
- Update GOLDEN_DIR in test_cfg_headers.rb to point to new location
- Add -f (fail-on-change) support to do_gen_cfg_headers_golden so
  './bin/chore gen -f cfg-headers' works for CI verification
- Replace regress-udb-gen-unit-test matrix job with a simple
  regress-cfg-headers job running './bin/chore gen -f cfg-headers',
  following the same pattern as regress-gen-ext-pdf for Xqci
- Add cfg-c-header and cfg-svh-header to bin/generate wrapper
- Regenerate .github/workflows/regress.yml

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Merge upstream main into cfg_c_header

Fix description in SVH generator (backtick wording).

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

feat: prefix parameter defines with UDB_ in generated headers

All configuration parameter #defines now have a UDB_ prefix to avoid
naming conflicts with user-defined macros. Extension presence defines
(NAME_SUPPORTED) and ISA width defines (XLEN, FLEN) are unchanged.

Also fix bin/chore to use 'bundle exec udb-gen' instead of $RUBY +
source_setup (which was undefined) for golden file generation.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

fix: address review comments on cfg header generator

- Sort string-array param defines for deterministic output
- Make simplecov require graceful (rescue LoadError) in test_helper.rb
- Clarify Integer params convention comment: UDB_NAME_value -> UDB_NAME_<value>
- Regenerate golden files to reflect comment change

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
